summary.text: Brooke Carter is the One Nation candidate for Oakleigh at the 2026 election. According to the ABC's candidate notes, she has spent over 25 years working in the legal system and the public sector. Her One Nation candidate page could not be read for this profile, and no other published biography was found.

occupation.text: Legal system and public sector work (more than 25 years)

summary.text: Hsiang-Han Hsieh, a psychiatrist in the public mental health system, is the Greens candidate for Oakleigh at the 2026 election. Raised in the Philippines, he came to Australia to study biomedicine and then medicine at the University of Melbourne. He also stood for the Greens in Oakleigh in 2022, finishing third with 16.6% of the primary vote.

priorities.text: a progressive, trustworthy and sensible voice for everyone
Relief from rising housing and healthcare costs
Higher taxes on large corporations and polluters

sources.title: Hsiang-Han Hsieh, Candidate for Oakleigh, Victorian Greens
Candidates of the 2022 Victorian state election, Wikipedia

summary.text: Martin Jung is the Liberal candidate for Oakleigh at the 2026 election. He works in his family's small business, has been an electorate officer and holds a social work degree from Deakin University. He has been a ReachOut Australia youth ambassador, has campaigned on youth mental health, and sits on the Waverley Hockey Club executive.

occupation.text: Works in his family's small business

priorities.text: Youth mental health, including early intervention
Making Oakleigh safer and less crime
A lower cost of living and more affordable housing in Oakleigh
Support for local families, multicultural communities and small businesses

sources.title: Martin Jung, Liberal for Oakleigh, Liberal Victoria

summary.text: Matthew Grinter is the Family First candidate for Oakleigh at the 2026 Victorian election, named for the seat by both the ABC guide and the party's list of Victorian candidates. Neither source had published a biography of him as at early November 2026.

sources.title: Oakleigh: 2026 Victorian election guide, ABC News
Victorian State Election 2026, Family First Party Australia

summary.text: Rowdy Bugter is the Victorian Socialists candidate for Oakleigh at the 2026 election. A carpenter in commercial construction, he is a rank-and-file member of the CFMEU and rents in Murrumbeena. His party page says he has organised socialist activity in the area for more than a year and has taken part in anti-racism, Palestine solidarity and climate campaigns.

priorities.text: I'll fight for the rights and wages of all workers in Australia
Stronger safety standards on construction sites
Wage rises that keep pace with the cost of living
Opposing racism and building unity among workers of all backgrounds

summary.text: Steve Dimopoulos has been the Labor MP for Oakleigh since 2014 and a minister since 2022. His portfolios have included tourism, sport and major events, creative industries and the environment, and since August 2026 he has been Minister for WorkSafe and the TAC, Sport, and Equality. He is a former Mayor of Monash and is recontesting Oakleigh in 2026.
